prompt: Build Secure Notes, one self-contained HTTP server that runs on Node's standard library alone (http, crypto, url, fs, path; no npm, no frameworks) and listens on the port in process.env.PORT, defaulting to 8100, bound to 127.0.0.1. It is a private notes service: a visitor registers a username and password, logs in to receive a session cookie, and from then on can create, list, read and delete notes that belong only to them. Passwords are never stored in the clear: each is kept as an scrypt hash beside a per-user random salt in ./data/users.json, and notes live in ./data/notes.json. A logged-in user can open a note as an HTML page at /notes/:id/view, where the note body is HTML-escaped so a note can never inject script. Static assets are served from a fixed ./public directory with a path-traversal guard; every response carries security headers; repeated failed logins for a username are locked out; session tokens are long random hex values sent HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict; and a crafted JSON body (an attacker sending __proto__) can never pollute Object.prototype. Write your own implementation from scratch; it must boot with no arguments and be safe to attack on localhost.
definition_of_done: final_output_file: server.js, one self-contained Node script using only the standard library (http, crypto, url, fs, path). All cases in test_acceptance.py pass via `python -I -m unittest discover -s . -v` with exit code 0; the suite spawns `node server.js` with PORT set to a free port and CWD at the server's directory, and skips (never fails) when node is missing. The user store is ./data/users.json and the note store is ./data/notes.json, both created under the process working directory; ./public is created with an index.html if absent so GET / always answers. The numbered rules, each scored by one test: 1. POST /register {username,password} creates a user and returns 2xx; a duplicate username is refused (4xx) and a password shorter than 8 characters is refused (4xx) [test_func_register]. 2. POST /login {username,password} with correct credentials returns 200 with a Set-Cookie: session=... header; wrong credentials return 401 [test_func_login]. 3. GET /api/notes without a valid session returns 401 [test_func_session_required]. 4. POST /api/notes {title,body} with a session creates a note owned by that user and returns its id, and GET /api/notes returns only that user's notes [test_func_create_and_list]. 5. GET /api/notes/:id returns the note when the caller owns it [test_func_get_own_note]. 6. DELETE /api/notes/:id deletes the note when the caller owns it, and afterwards GET /api/notes/:id is 404 [test_func_delete]. 7. POST /logout invalidates the session and the old cookie is then rejected with 401 [test_func_logout]. 8. Passwords are stored only as an scrypt hash plus a per-user random salt in ./data/users.json; the raw password never appears there [test_sec_password_not_plaintext]. 9. The session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict [test_sec_session_httponly_samesite]. 10. Session tokens are at least 32 characters, unique per login and high-entropy, from crypto.randomBytes [test_sec_session_token_entropy]. 11. Every /api/notes route requires a valid session; anonymous access is 401 [test_sec_auth_required_on_notes]. 12. A user cannot read or delete another user's note by id: cross-user access returns 404 with no hint the note exists, so there is no IDOR [test_sec_idor_cross_user]. 13. GET /notes/:id/view HTML-escapes the note body, so a body of <script>alert(1)</script> is neutralised and there is no stored XSS [test_sec_stored_xss_escaped]. 14. GET /static/* rejects path traversal (../, %2f, %2e%2e, backslash, absolute paths) and never serves a file outside ./public, in particular never server.js [test_sec_path_traversal_blocked]. 15. No long hex or base64 secret is hardcoded in server.js; session material comes from crypto.randomBytes (or from an environment variable) [test_sec_no_hardcoded_secret]. 16. After 5 failed logins for a username, further attempts are refused with HTTP 429 for a lockout window [test_sec_login_rate_limited]. 17. Every response carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY and a Content-Security-Policy [test_sec_security_headers]. 18. A JSON body cannot pollute Object.prototype; after posting a body containing __proto__, the route GET /api/_probe reports {"safe": true} [test_sec_proto_pollution_blocked]. 19. Password comparison uses crypto.timingSafeEqual and a wrong password is rejected [test_sec_timing_safe_compare]. If the contract cannot be satisfied, return status='failure' with the precise reason rather than a server that games the tests.
contract: Return ONE complete Node script in the `code` field, saved as server.js. It must require only the Node standard library: http, crypto, url, fs and path. No npm packages, no external processes, no network calls out. Read the listen port from process.env.PORT and default to 8100; bind 127.0.0.1. At startup create ./data and ./public (recursive) and, if ./public/index.html is absent, write a small placeholder there so GET / always answers. Persist users to ./data/users.json as a map username -> {salt, hash} (both hex) and notes to ./data/notes.json as an array of {id, owner, title, body, created}; load them at startup if present. Routes, exactly: GET / serves ./public/index.html; GET /static/<subpath> serves a file under ./public with a path-traversal guard that decodes the subpath, strips leading separators, resolves against ./public and refuses anything landing outside it (../, %2f, %2e%2e, backslash and absolute paths all blocked); POST /register {username,password}; POST /login {username,password}; POST /logout; GET /api/notes; POST /api/notes {title,body}; GET /api/notes/:id; DELETE /api/notes/:id; GET /notes/:id/view (HTML page, owner-only, body HTML-escaped); GET /api/_probe returns {"safe": <Object.prototype was not polluted>} for the prototype-pollution check. Ids are unguessable (crypto.randomBytes hex). Sessions: on login set Set-Cookie: session=<token> with token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), and the attributes HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; keep a server-side map token -> username; /logout clears it and expires the cookie. Hash passwords with crypto.scryptSync over a per-user crypto.randomBytes salt and compare with crypto.timingSafeEqual. Reject weak (<8 chars) and duplicate registrations. Rate-limit login: after 5 failures for a username, answer 429 for a lockout window. Every response, through a single send helper, carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY and a Content-Security-Policy. Parse request JSON through a guard that drops __proto__, constructor and prototype keys so no body can pollute Object.prototype; keep server-side maps as null-prototype objects. No secret literal in the source; all key material is crypto.randomBytes at startup or from env. Division of labour for the swarm, one `// part:NAME` block each: imports owns `// part:imports` (requires, constants, startup dir creation); store owns `// part:store` (JSON load/save and the in-memory maps); hashing owns `// part:hashing` (scrypt hash and timing-safe verify); sessions owns `// part:sessions` (token creation, cookie parse/format, session lookup); register owns `// part:register`; login owns `// part:login`; logout owns `// part:logout`; noteslist owns `// part:noteslist` (GET /api/notes); notecreate owns `// part:notecreate` (POST /api/notes); noteget owns `// part:noteget` (GET /api/notes/:id); notedelete owns `// part:notedelete` (DELETE /api/notes/:id); staticserve owns `// part:staticserve` (GET / and GET /static/*); htmlview owns `// part:htmlview` (GET /notes/:id/view and HTML escaping); headers owns `// part:headers` (the security-header send helpers); ratelimit owns `// part:ratelimit`; jsonguard owns `// part:jsonguard` (safe JSON parsing). The HTTP dispatch that wires the routes and the /api/_probe route sit outside every block and stay frozen. securityskeptic, pentester, referee and measurer own no block: they review. Standard library only; no npm, no external assets, no outbound network of any kind.

import json
import os
import re
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import time
import unittest
from shutil import which
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
from urllib.error import HTTPError

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SERVER = os.path.join(HERE, "server.js")
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(HERE, "data")
USERS_FILE = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "users.json")
STDERR_LOG = os.path.join(HERE, "_server_stderr.log")

GOOD_PW = "Str0ng-Pass_9x"
RUN_ID = os.urandom(3).hex()

PROC = None
ERRFILE = None
BASE = None
_counter = [0]


def _node():
    return which("node") or which("node.exe")


def _free_port():
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port


def setUpModule():
    global PROC, ERRFILE, BASE
    if _node() is None:
        raise unittest.SkipTest("node is required to run server.js")
    port = _free_port()
    env = dict(os.environ, PORT=str(port))
    ERRFILE = open(STDERR_LOG, "wb")
    PROC = subprocess.Popen(
        [_node(), SERVER], cwd=HERE, env=env,
        stdout=ERRFILE, stderr=ERRFILE,
        start_new_session=(os.name != "nt"),
    )
    BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port
    deadline = time.time() + 15
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            with urlopen(BASE + "/", timeout=1) as resp:
                resp.read()
            return
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.25)
    tail = ""
    try:
        ERRFILE.flush()
        with open(STDERR_LOG, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            tail = fh.read()[-800:]
    except Exception:
        pass
    raise RuntimeError("server.js did not answer GET / within 15s. stderr tail:\n" + tail)


def tearDownModule():
    global PROC, ERRFILE
    if PROC is not None and PROC.poll() is None:
        try:
            if os.name == "nt":
                subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(PROC.pid), "/T", "/F"],
                               capture_output=True)
            else:
                os.killpg(os.getpgid(PROC.pid), signal.SIGTERM)
        except Exception:
            try:
                PROC.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass
    if ERRFILE is not None:
        try:
            ERRFILE.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


def _req(method, path, data=None, cookie=None, headers=None):
    h = dict(headers or {})
    body = None
    if data is not None:
        body = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
        h.setdefault("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if cookie:
        h["Cookie"] = cookie
    req = Request(BASE + path, data=body, method=method, headers=h)
    try:
        resp = urlopen(req, timeout=5)
        code, text, hdrs = resp.getcode(), resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), resp.headers
        resp.close()
        return code, text, hdrs
    except HTTPError as exc:
        code, text, hdrs = exc.code, exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), exc.headers
        exc.close()
        return code, text, hdrs


def _new_username():
    _counter[0] += 1
    return "u%s_%03d" % (RUN_ID, _counter[0])


def _register(username, password=GOOD_PW):
    return _req("POST", "/register", {"username": username, "password": password})


def _login(username, password=GOOD_PW):
    code, body, hdrs = _req("POST", "/login", {"username": username, "password": password})
    setc = hdrs.get("Set-Cookie", "") or ""
    token = setc.split(";")[0] if setc else ""
    return code, token, setc


def _account():
    """Register a fresh user and return (username, session-cookie)."""
    username = _new_username()
    _register(username)
    code, cookie, _ = _login(username)
    return username, cookie, code


class Functional(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_func_register(self):
        username = _new_username()
        code, body, _ = _register(username)
        self.assertIn(code, (200, 201), "registering a fresh user should succeed: %s" % body)
        dup_code, _, _ = _register(username)
        self.assertIn(dup_code, (400, 409, 422), "a duplicate username must be rejected")
        weak_code, _, _ = _register(_new_username(), "short")
        self.assertIn(weak_code, (400, 422), "a weak password must be rejected")

    def test_func_login(self):
        username = _new_username()
        _register(username)
        code, cookie, setc = _login(username)
        self.assertEqual(code, 200, "correct credentials should log in")
        self.assertTrue(cookie.startswith("session="), "login must set a session cookie")
        bad_code, _, _ = _login(username, "wrong-password-xyz")
        self.assertIn(bad_code, (401, 403), "a wrong password must be refused")

    def test_func_session_required(self):
        code, _, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes")
        self.assertEqual(code, 401, "listing notes without a session must be 401")

    def test_func_create_and_list(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        code, body, _ = _req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "T1", "body": "hello"}, cookie=cookie)
        self.assertIn(code, (200, 201), "creating a note should succeed")
        note_id = json.loads(body)["id"]
        self.assertTrue(note_id, "create must return a note id")
        code, body, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes", cookie=cookie)
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)
        listed = json.loads(body)["notes"]
        self.assertIn(note_id, [n["id"] for n in listed], "the new note must appear in the owner's list")

    def test_func_get_own_note(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        _, body, _ = _req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "Mine", "body": "secret text"}, cookie=cookie)
        note_id = json.loads(body)["id"]
        code, body, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes/" + note_id, cookie=cookie)
        self.assertEqual(code, 200, "the owner can read their note")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["body"], "secret text")

    def test_func_delete(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        _, body, _ = _req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "Doomed", "body": "bye"}, cookie=cookie)
        note_id = json.loads(body)["id"]
        code, _, _ = _req("DELETE", "/api/notes/" + note_id, cookie=cookie)
        self.assertIn(code, (200, 204), "the owner can delete their note")
        code, _, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes/" + note_id, cookie=cookie)
        self.assertEqual(code, 404, "a deleted note is gone")

    def test_func_logout(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        code, _, _ = _req("POST", "/logout", cookie=cookie)
        self.assertIn(code, (200, 204), "logout should succeed")
        code, _, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes", cookie=cookie)
        self.assertEqual(code, 401, "the session must be invalid after logout")


class Security(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sec_password_not_plaintext(self):
        username = _new_username()
        secret = "PlAinTextCanary_%s!" % RUN_ID
        _register(username, secret)
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(USERS_FILE), "the user store must live at ./data/users.json")
        with open(USERS_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            store = fh.read()
        self.assertNotIn(secret, store, "the raw password must never be stored")
        self.assertRegex(store, r"salt", "a per-user salt must be stored")
        self.assertRegex(store, r"hash", "a password hash must be stored")
        self.assertRegex(store, r"[0-9a-fA-F]{32,}", "the stored hash must look like a digest")

    def test_sec_session_httponly_samesite(self):
        username = _new_username()
        _register(username)
        _, _, setc = _login(username)
        self.assertRegex(setc, r"(?i)HttpOnly", "the session cookie must be HttpOnly")
        self.assertRegex(setc, r"(?i)SameSite\s*=\s*Strict", "the session cookie must be SameSite=Strict")

    def test_sec_session_token_entropy(self):
        u1 = _new_username(); _register(u1)
        u2 = _new_username(); _register(u2)
        _, c1, _ = _login(u1)
        _, c2, _ = _login(u2)
        t1 = c1.split("=", 1)[1] if "=" in c1 else ""
        t2 = c2.split("=", 1)[1] if "=" in c2 else ""
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(t1), 32, "a session token must be long")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(t2), 32)
        self.assertNotEqual(t1, t2, "two sessions must get different tokens")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(set(t1)), 8, "a session token must be high-entropy, not a counter")

    def test_sec_auth_required_on_notes(self):
        self.assertEqual(_req("GET", "/api/notes")[0], 401)
        self.assertEqual(_req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "x", "body": "y"})[0], 401)
        self.assertEqual(_req("GET", "/api/notes/deadbeef")[0], 401)

    def test_sec_idor_cross_user(self):
        _, cookie_a, _ = _account()
        _, body, _ = _req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "A", "body": "A private"}, cookie=cookie_a)
        note_id = json.loads(body)["id"]
        _, cookie_b, _ = _account()
        code, _, _ = _req("GET", "/api/notes/" + note_id, cookie=cookie_b)
        self.assertEqual(code, 404, "another user must not read the note, and must not learn it exists")
        code, _, _ = _req("DELETE", "/api/notes/" + note_id, cookie=cookie_b)
        self.assertEqual(code, 404, "another user must not delete the note")

    def test_sec_stored_xss_escaped(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        payload = "<script>alert(1)</script>"
        _, body, _ = _req("POST", "/api/notes", {"title": "XSS", "body": payload}, cookie=cookie)
        note_id = json.loads(body)["id"]
        code, html, _ = _req("GET", "/notes/" + note_id + "/view", cookie=cookie)
        self.assertEqual(code, 200, "the owner can view the note page")
        self.assertNotIn(payload, html, "the raw script tag must not appear unescaped")
        self.assertIn("alert(1)", html, "the note text should still render, but neutralised")

    def test_sec_path_traversal_blocked(self):
        variants = [
            "/static/../server.js",
            "/static/..%2f..%2fserver.js",
            "/static/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/server.js",
            "/static/....//....//server.js",
            "/static/..%5c..%5cserver.js",
        ]
        for path in variants:
            code, body, _ = _req("GET", path)
            self.assertNotIn("createServer", body, "%s leaked server source" % path)
            self.assertNotIn("scryptSync", body, "%s leaked server source" % path)

    def test_sec_no_hardcoded_secret(self):
        with open(SERVER, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            source = fh.read()
        self.assertIn("crypto.randomBytes", source,
                      "session/secret material must come from crypto.randomBytes")
        secretish = re.compile(
            r"(?i)(secret|api[_-]?key|signing[_-]?key|token|seed|salt|password)\s*[:=]\s*"
            r"['\"](?:[0-9a-f]{16,}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,}={0,2})['\"]")
        self.assertIsNone(secretish.search(source),
                          "no long hex/base64 secret may be hardcoded in the source")

    def test_sec_login_rate_limited(self):
        username = _new_username()
        _register(username)
        codes = []
        for _ in range(8):
            codes.append(_login(username, "definitely-wrong")[0])
        self.assertTrue(any(c in (429, 423, 403) for c in codes),
                        "after repeated bad logins the account must be locked/throttled, got %r" % codes)

    def test_sec_security_headers(self):
        _, _, headers = _req("GET", "/")
        self.assertRegex((headers.get("X-Content-Type-Options") or ""), r"(?i)nosniff")
        self.assertRegex((headers.get("X-Frame-Options") or ""), r"(?i)DENY")
        self.assertTrue(headers.get("Content-Security-Policy"), "a Content-Security-Policy must be set")

    def test_sec_proto_pollution_blocked(self):
        _, cookie, _ = _account()
        payload = {"__proto__": {"polluted": True}, "title": "p", "body": "p"}
        _req("POST", "/register", {"username": _new_username(), "password": GOOD_PW, "__proto__": {"polluted": True}})
        _req("POST", "/api/notes", payload, cookie=cookie)
        code, body, _ = _req("GET", "/api/_probe")
        self.assertEqual(code, 200, "the probe route must answer")
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(body).get("safe"), "Object.prototype was polluted by a crafted body")

    def test_sec_timing_safe_compare(self):
        with open(SERVER, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            source = fh.read()
        self.assertIn("timingSafeEqual", source,
                      "password comparison must use crypto.timingSafeEqual")
        username = _new_username()
        _register(username)
        self.assertIn(_login(username, "wrong-one")[0], (401, 403),
                      "a wrong password must be rejected")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
